basic_details.job_title: TMC Senior Resident (Transfusion Medicine) Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Tata Memorial Centre (TMC), a grant-in-aid institute under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India, will hold a walk-in interview for the post of Senior Resident in the Department of Transfusion Medicine on 18 November 2026, with reporting between 09:00 A.M. and 10:00 A.M. The venue is Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Aganampudi, Gajuwaka Mandalam, Visakhapatnam, Pincode:-530053. content_sections.heading: About the Hospital
content_sections.text: Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre (HBCHRC), Aganampudi, Visakhapatnam, is a peripheral centre of Tata Memorial Centre, which describes itself in the notice as a grant-in-aid institute under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. The notice is signed by Prof S.S. Laskar, Director (Academics), TMC, and the Senior Resident post advertised is in the Department of Transfusion Medicine.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: TMC has invited applications from Indian Nationals for one post name, Senior Resident in the Department of Transfusion Medicine. The essential qualification is MD (Immuno-Haematology and Blood Transfusion / Transfusion Medicine OR equivalent PG degree. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post. The age limit is 40 years. The notice does not print a date as on which age is counted. The consolidated remuneration is MD/DNB- Rs.1,33,623/- p.m. (Gross Pay). The tenure is up to 31.07.2027. Senior Residents may be provided sharing accommodation subject to availability; hostel charges of Rs.9,000/- will be deducted every month from their salary.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Detailed resume A recent passport size photograph Attested copies of all qualification and experience certificates For candidates working under Central / State Government / Autonomous Body / Semi Government Organizations: a No Objection Certificate through the Head of their Institution, along with all original educational and experience certificates Candidates interested in the walk-in interview are requested to report directly to the hospital at Aganampudi, Gajuwaka Mandalam, Visakhapatnam on 18 November 2026 with these documents. The notice does not ask for any application to be sent in advance.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Appointed candidates will be placed as per needs of the Departments of Tata Memorial Centre in its peripheral centre, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre Visakhapatnam. Preference will be given to candidates who agree to be placed in the Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre Visakhapatnam Centre only. Sharing accommodation is subject to availability. Doubts regarding the post may be clarified by emailing [email protected] or by telephone on 0891-2871 538.

faq.question: Q1. When is the TMC Senior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Senior Resident (Transfusion Medicine) is on 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the TMC Senior Resident walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates must report between 09:00 A.M. and 10:00 A.M. at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Aganampudi, Gajuwaka Mandalam, Visakhapatnam, Pincode:-530053.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the TMC Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is MD (Immuno-Haematology and Blood Transfusion / Transfusion Medicine OR equivalent PG degree.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the TMC Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for Physically Handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a TMC Senior Resident in Transfusion Medicine?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is MD/DNB- Rs.1,33,623/- p.m. (Gross Pay).

faq.question: Q6. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring a detailed resume, a recent passport size photograph and attested copies of all qualification and experience certificates. Those working under Central / State Government / Autonomous Body / Semi Government Organizations must also bring a No Objection Certificate through the Head of their Institution and all original educational and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the TMC Senior Resident appointment?
faq.answer: The tenure is up to 31 July 2027.

faq.question: Q8. Is accommodation provided to Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Senior Residents may be provided sharing accommodation subject to availability, and hostel charges of Rs.9,000/- will be deducted every month from their salary.

faq.question: Q9. Where will selected Senior Residents be placed?
faq.answer: Appointed candidates will be placed as per needs of the Departments of Tata Memorial Centre in its peripheral centre, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre Visakhapatnam, and preference will be given to candidates who agree to be placed in the Visakhapatnam centre only.
